top_story: US strikes on Iranian targets in Qeshm, Bushehr, and elsewhere overnight on 29–30 July pushed a volatile US-Iran confrontation into a more dangerous phase, with Jordan intercepting missiles soon after and Tehran signaling retaliation through pressure on US allies rather than direct de-escalation. The near-term outlook is for diplomacy to survive only in parallel with widening retaliation cycles, while the human costs across Iran, Gaza, and neighboring states continue to mount fastest.
